research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tagore Technology is developing gallium nitride power devices and control circuits for radio frequency applications. Work such as Gate bias circuit for a driver monolithically integrated with a GaN power FET and Under voltage lock-out circuit focuses on monolithic GaN integration and supply protection, while Temperature-adaptive gate driver for GaN switch addresses gate to source voltage tuning with temperature, highlighting research in GaN power stages, drivers and protection circuitry.

about_short_description.short_description: Tagore Technology is a semiconductor company that manufactures radio frequency products.

product.name: TSL8028N RF Receiver Front-End Module
product.description: An integrated RF front-end module combining a 2-stage GaAs low noise amplifier and a GaN SPDT switch for 2-5 GHz wireless infrastructure applications.

product.name: High Power GaN RF Switches
product.description: RF switches using Gallium Nitride technology supporting power levels from 10W to 200W, operating from 1 MHz to 7 GHz, designed to replace PIN diode switches.

product.name: MCM Switch-LNA Modules
product.description: Multi-chip modules integrating RF switches and low noise amplifiers for improved front-end performance in RF systems.

product.name: Wideband GaN Power Amplifier Devices
product.description: Gallium Nitride-based power amplifiers designed for wideband RF applications requiring high power output and efficiency.

product.name: GaAs Low Noise Amplifiers
product.description: Low noise amplifiers based on Gallium Arsenide technology for enhancing signal reception in RF front-end systems.

product.name: Resilient Low Noise Amplifiers
product.description: Low noise amplifiers designed for robust operation in challenging RF environments to maintain signal integrity.
